questions.q: What data would hurt most if it were encrypted or deleted tomorrow?
questions.why: Points straight at the buckets that need immutability first.
questions.need: The data that would hurt most is known and protected first
questions.how: Name it with the business, and protect it first

questions.q: What do you pay today per terabyte, including egress and requests?
questions.why: Request and egress fees are where storage bills surprise people.
questions.need: The full cost per terabyte is known
questions.how: Add up storage, egress and requests for a typical month

questions.q: Which applications and backup jobs write to object storage, and where?
questions.why: Unknown writers mean unknown tenants and keys.
questions.need: Every application and backup job writing to object storage is known

questions.q: Do you know how many access keys exist, who owns them and when they were last used?
questions.why: Old keys with broad rights are the easiest way in.
questions.need: Every access key has an owner and is used
questions.how: Review keys, give owners, and remove unused ones

questions.q: Are your backup copies under object lock, and for how long?
questions.why: Backups an administrator can delete do not survive ransomware.
questions.need: Backup copies are under object lock for long enough
questions.how: Turn on object lock with the agreed retention

questions.q: Must any data stay in a given country, and can you prove where it is?
questions.why: Residency is often a legal requirement before it is a technical one.
questions.need: Data that must stay in a country stays there, with proof
questions.how: Pin buckets to regions and keep the evidence

questions.q: When did you last restore from these backups, and how long did it take?
questions.why: The restore is the only test that counts.
questions.need: A restore from object storage has been tested and timed
questions.how: Restore one backup end to end and time it

questions.q: Who is alerted when someone reads or deletes far more than usual?
questions.why: Mass reads and deletes are the first signs of theft or ransomware.
questions.need: Unusual reads or deletes alert someone named
questions.how: Alert on unusual volumes, routed to an owner
